text: I had a really long day at work and I just want to talk about something light.
Do you ever get tired of people asking you the same questions?
My friend cancelled our plans again and I am a bit upset about it.
What do you think makes a good conversation?
Can you tell me something interesting about the ocean?
I cannot decide whether to move to a new city for a job.
What is the best way to stay calm before an exam?
My dog learned a new trick today and I am so proud of him.
I am trying to cook dinner for my family tonight. Any simple ideas?
Sometimes I feel like I am not good enough at my job.
I watched an amazing movie yesterday and I cannot stop thinking about it.
How do you handle it when someone disagrees with you?
Do you think people can really change their habits?
I am so excited, I am going on a trip next week.
Can you help me plan my weekend? I have only two free days.
I just finished a long run and I feel great.
I am learning a new language and the grammar is confusing me.
Why do we dream, do you think?
I need a little motivation to finish my project tonight.
Tell me about a place you would like to visit if you could.
Yaar aaj office mein bahut kaam tha, thak gaya hoon. Tum batao kya chal raha hai?
Mujhe samajh nahi aa raha ki main naya phone lun ya purana hi chalaun.
Aaj kal neend nahi aa rahi, kuch tips hain kya?
Mere dost ne mujhse jhooth bola aur mujhe bura lag raha hai.
Tumhe kaun sa khana sabse zyada pasand hai, batao na?
Main Bangalore shift ho raha hoon, thoda dar bhi lag raha hai.
Mujhe lagta hai main apne career mein kuch galat kar raha hoon.
Weekend pe kya karna chahiye, koi achha idea do.
Kya tum mujhe ek mazedaar kahani suna sakte ho?
Exam ka bahut tension hai, padhai mein mann nahi lag raha.
Cricket match dekha kya kal? Kya zabardast khel tha!
Mujhe apne baare mein confidence nahi aata, kya karun?
Mera flat number teen zero do hai, society ka gate band ho jaata hai raat ko.
Yaar ye traffic mein roz ek ghanta barbaad ho jaata hai.
Mujhe nayi job ka offer mila hai, par salary thodi kam hai.
Chai pe charcha karte hain, tum chai peete ho ya coffee?
Main bahut dino se gym nahi gaya, wapas shuru karna hai.
Kabhi kabhi lagta hai sab kuch ek saath ho raha hai, bahut overwhelm ho jaata hoon.
Aaj ka din bahut accha tha, bas thoda baat karna chahta tha.
Meri dadi ke haath ka khana bahut yaad aata hai.
